subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Stack Overflow: Saving Developers Daily
description: A quick win: understand Stack Overflow: Saving Developers Daily.

hook.text: Joel Spolsky and Jeff Atwood noticed developers wasted hours searching for coding answers.

buildup.text: Stack Overflow launched in 2008 as a Q&A site where the best answers rise to the top.

discovery.text: Gamification — reputation points and badges — motivated experts to answer for free.

twist.text: A study found that a typical developer visits Stack Overflow multiple times per day.

climax.text: Stack Overflow became the world's largest developer knowledge base, shaping how code gets written.

punchline.text: Developers taught each other and built the web.

quiz.question: What motivates experts to answer on Stack Overflow?
